name: Give Gerard a Drink
summary: At the Maclure Vineyards, Gerard Tiller works long days in the fields and needs fresh spring water. Passing travelers bring water and trade it for apples.

sections.title: Thirsty Work in the Vineyard Fields
sections.body: Elwynn's farms supply grain, fruit, and vegetables to Stormwind's townsfolk and garrisons. The work is hot beneath the open sky. At the Maclure Vineyards, Gerard Tiller tends the crops, keeps pests away, and manages the harvest. With little time to reach the town wells, he depends on passing recruits to bring clean spring water so he can keep working.

sections.title: The Economy of Barter
sections.body: Gerard trades provisions for water instead of coin. Travelers with extra flasks of Refreshing Spring Water can exchange them for fresh apples from his orchard. The kingdom stretches its resources to keep order and feed its army. So barter between smallholders and recruits remains a practical way to get by in rural Elwynn.

faq.answer: Gerard Tiller farms at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest. He tends the fields and orchards that supply local residents.
Working in the fields under the sun all day is exhausting. Gerard relies on passing travelers for fresh spring water so he can stay hydrated without leaving his chores.

faq.q: Where can Refreshing Spring Water be found?
faq.answer: Food and drink vendors and innkeepers throughout Elwynn Forest commonly sell Refreshing Spring Water. Brother Danil sells it inside Northshire Abbey.
Yes. Gerard keeps working the fields and trades fresh orchard apples for more bottles of water you can spare.

faq.q: What does Gerard offer in return for the drink?
faq.answer: Gerard trades a Shiny Red Apple for fresh water.
Gerard is outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: Supporting Elwynn's farmers at places like the Maclure Vineyards helps feed the forest's homesteads and garrisons while the kingdom defends itself.
As a human starting in Northshire, helping neighbors like Gerard Tiller shows the communal spirit that holds Elwynn together.
